Stored Game Tiles

Tiles generated before and kept on the server, most recently made first; click a column heading to sort by it. Open a tile to change it in the generator; files marked "ready" download at once, others are made when you ask for them. Every tile type is also made as a 40 mm square with the default settings while the server has nothing else to do. Tiles made by an older version of the generator are kept too, marked "older", until a newer version of the same tile (all settings the same) is made: their files are as they were made then, and opening one in the generator makes it with the current version, which can differ. The least recently used files are deleted when the store gets full.
